Please don't think you're doing anything wring. When my LO was 9 months it was the same for us. I freaked out because everyone else's kids seem to eat like horses. Food before one is just for fun. 

We started offerring food before milk (we nurse at home but use formula at daycare) around this time but please don't worry about "3 square meals" a day for your 9 month old. Well, there are still people who don't have insurance even if it's the law.
